column4: Customers moving in/out need a truck — highest-intent referrals
Same customers as PMs; reciprocal referrals (you refer them, they refer you)
Reciprocal referral partner on every vacate
High-value whole-household moves; they coordinate, you carry
Constant furniture moves + wealthy relocating clients
Staging = moving furniture in/out of listed homes
Delivery contracts + refer customers buying a houseful
Every purchase = a move; warm hand-off to new owners
Settlement date = moving day; natural referral moment
